versions.subject: refactore: split up rule for CVE-2020-1048 into 2 rules
versions.detection:
selection1:
    CommandLine|contains|all: 
        - 'Add-PrinterPort -Name'
        - '.dll'
selection2:
    CommandLine|contains|all: 
        - 'Add-PrinterPort -Name'
        - '.exe'
selection3:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'Generic / Text Only'
condition: 1 of them
versions.spl: (CommandLine="*Add-PrinterPort -Name*" CommandLine="*.dll*") OR (CommandLine="*Add-PrinterPort -Name*" CommandLine="*.exe*") OR CommandLine="*Generic / Text Only*"

versions.subject: refactor: simplified and extended expression in CVE-2020-1048 rule
